rules.name: HOME OF THE ISLAND'S HEART
rules.turn: add-presence S, spirit:special S home-of-the-islands-heart, (presence-choice S C), !(inland C)
rules.evidence: seeds 1-4: move u2 l3; seed 7: move u2 l2 -- never l1 (coastal) or sea
rules.notes: One extra `!` on the base add-presence choice. 'Inland' had to be added as board data (+inland facts): it is the complement of coastal and acc bodies have no negation. Only 'added' is covered; core has no verb for moving Presence, so 'moved' would need the same constraint on that future choice.
rules.text: Your [Presence] may only be added/moved to lands that are Inland.

rules.name: ENTHRALL THE FOREIGN EXPLORERS
rules.turn:
#acc enthralled-land : spirit land
spirit:special S enthrall-the-foreign-explorers, presence-count S L N, land L / enthralled-land S L
invaders-deal-damage L, enthralled-land S L, at P L, piece:kind P explorer, { deals L P D => }
invaders-deal-damage L, enthralled-land S L, presence-count S L N,
  land:count L explorer E, mul N 2 Out, minus E Out R0, pos R0 R,
  kind:damage explorer D, mul R D X
  / invader-damage L X
rules.evidence: 1 Presence, 2 Explorers + Town in l1: deals l1 town 2 only, damage-land l1 2; with 3 Explorers: damage-land l1 3
rules.notes: Explorers are interchangeable, so instead of choosing which sit out, every Explorer's per-invader `deals` is suppressed by an exception and max(0, E - 2N) Explorer damage is added back as extra invader-damage rows. Works only because core exposes per-invader damage as tuples summed by an @sum acc. Not covered: non-participating Explorers can still be destroyed by Dahan counterattack, because core's kill-invaders choice is anonymous (no ~choice tuple), so no rule can add a constraint to it.
rules.text: For each of your [Presence] in a land, up to 2 [Explorer] do not participate in Ravage.

language_issues: No negation in acc bodies, so 'Inland' (= not coastal) had to be entered as data rather than derived.

An anonymous inline choice (`?[rng] V, !(...), is V X` as in core's kill-invaders) cannot be narrowed by other rules; only choices that emit a naming tuple (like presence-choice / push-to) are extensible.
